summary: Implementation plan for lightweight file-based caching in clarify-api (Laravel REST API connecting to Supabase PostgreSQL) without Redis or external dependencies. Covers Cache::remember() in AnnouncementController@index (10m), ChannelController@index (10m), and InstructorController@index (30m), targeted cache invalidation in AnnouncementObserver and ChannelController, and config/cache.php, .env.example, and config/cors.php configuration.
